title: STR Investing in NC High Country: Honest Analysis
excerpt: The High Country draws visitors year-round, and many buyers are eyeing short-term rental income as a reason to pull the trigger on mountain property NC. Here's an honest, county-by-county look at what STR investing actually looks like in Watauga, Avery, and Ashe.
